title: IELTS Academic 21 - Listening Test 4 - Part 3
transcriptHtml:
LISTENING TRANSCRIPT - PART 3

💡 Audio-Track Sync: Bấm vào bất kỳ câu nào dưới đây để phát audio ngay đúng câu đó!

14:12ANNOUNCER: Part 3. You will hear two architecture students called Mia and Leo discussing their presentation on Houses of the Future.
14:21ANNOUNCER: First, you have some time to look at questions 21 to 23.
14:52ANNOUNCER: Now listen carefully and answer questions 21 to 23.
15:00MIA: You know that joint presentation we've got to do this semester, Leo?
15:04LEO: On houses of the future?
15:06MIA: That's right. I'm a bit concerned – are we meant to come up with creative new suggestions for these houses?
15:13LEO: I don't think so. It's more a matter of reporting and evaluating possible developments. But we mustn't be too general, we've got to support our points by referring to specific cases. So that'll need a lot of work.
15:28MIA: I'm afraid so. When's it got to be done by?
15:32LEO: In about 6 weeks, so that's not too much of a rush.
15:37MIA: Good. We'd better decide now what type of housing we're going to focus on. How about housing for different generations living together?
15:45LEO: We could do. Or accommodation for one person?
15:49MIA: I think someone else is doing that. I was wondering about housing for the elderly? That's likely to become more important.
15:58MIA: Yeah that's true. But I think your suggestion about intergenerational living might be more interesting – let's go with that.
16:07LEO: OK. Now I think the future demand is mainly going to be for accommodation in urban areas. So one way of meeting that demand might be to use existing commercial buildings and adapt them to form accommodation...
16:21MIA: ...or come up with original ways of organising space so that people can live in smaller homes. But I think the solution is to design multi-storey apartment blocks.
16:32LEO: Building up rather than out, yes.
16:38ANNOUNCER: Before you hear the rest of the discussion, you have some time to look at questions 24 to 30.
17:17ANNOUNCER: Now listen and answer questions 24 to 30.
17:25MIA: Let's think of some specific developments for houses of the future.
17:29LEO: OK. How about increased use of roof space on high-rise buildings for gardens?
17:35MIA: Yes. In fact it doesn't have to be high-rise... but it would greatly improve how you feel if you live in an urban high-rise. Especially if you don't have a balcony.
17:51MIA: Yes. I think homes of the future will all need access to a shared working space, somewhere in the same building or group of houses, where people can go and work instead of just having a laptop on the kitchen table.
18:04LEO: Yes, so they aren't having to travel to an office but can still interact with others. That's often how new ideas get generated – by chatting to someone from a different profession.
18:15MIA: Yeah. I read about a type of design where the internal walls of an apartment are moveable, so the space can be adapted over time as people's needs change.
18:25LEO: Like when children leave school and start working but still continue to live with their parents... Or when an elderly relative moves in... it would mean they could still have their own space, specially designed for their needs.
18:41MIA: Yes. Have you heard about those smart bathroom mirrors which can monitor people's health? They recognise signs of illness and contact a doctor automatically?
18:50LEO: Hmm, not so sure they're a good idea.
18:54MIA: Nor am I. People might worry about conditions which aren't serious at all.
19:01LEO: What about transport? Wouldn't it be good if there were bike sheds with charging points, so people could store their electric bikes securely and charge them up at the same time?
19:11MIA: Yes. That would encourage more people to cycle, instead of using their car. Much better for the planet.
19:18LEO: I read about one housing development where cars had to be left just outside it, so the centre was all a pedestrianised area. Great for families with children.
19:28MIA: Maybe. But what if you're disabled or elderly, and can't walk far? It wouldn't be so good for people like that.
19:35LEO: No.
19:36MIA: I saw a scheme for communal vegetable plots, where neighbours could decide what to grow together. That'd be a great way for older people to get to know one another, especially if they're no longer going out to work.
19:49LEO: Yes, doing something together's always more enjoyable, isn't it?
19:59ANNOUNCER: That is the end of Part 3. You now have 30 seconds to check your answers to Part 3.

groups.title: Questions 24–30
groups.instructions:
What opinion is given about each of the following developments?
Choose SEVEN answers from the box and write the correct letter, A–I, next to Questions 24–30.

options.text: This would be especially beneficial for city residents.
This would be challenging for young people.
This could lead to social problems.
This could enable retired people to share a project.
This would help some people but cause problems for others.
This would suit both existing and new members of a household.

q21.text: Which aspect of their presentation are Mia and Leo both concerned about?

steps: • Đáp án đúng: B (finding suitable examples)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'we've got to support our points by referring to specific cases. So that'll need a lot of work.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'referring to specific cases' = finding suitable examples.
• Phân tích bẫy: Thời hạn nộp là 6 tuần nên không vội ('not too much of a rush' -> loại A); không cần ý tưởng sáng tạo mới ('I don't think so... more a matter of reporting' -> loại C).

q22.text: The students decide to focus their assignment on housing for

steps: • Đáp án đúng: A (family groups)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'your suggestion about intergenerational living might be more interesting – let's go with that.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'intergenerational living (different generations living together)' = family groups.

q23.text: The students agree that demand for accommodation in urban areas should be met by
options: C. developing creative ideas for smaller homes.

steps: • Đáp án đúng: B (constructing tall buildings)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'solution is to design multi-storey apartment blocks. LEO: Building up rather than out, yes.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'multi-storey apartment blocks / building up' = constructing tall buildings.

q24.text: use of roof space for gardens

steps: • Đáp án đúng: B (This would be especially beneficial for city residents)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'greatly improve how you feel if you live in an urban high-rise.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'improve how you feel... urban high-rise' = beneficial for city residents.
• Đáp án đúng: E (This could encourage creativity)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'That's often how new ideas get generated – by chatting to someone from a different profession.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'new ideas get generated' = encourage creativity.
• Đáp án đúng: I (This would suit both existing and new members of a household)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'when children leave school and start working... Or when an elderly relative moves in with the family... have their own space...'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'children continue to live (existing) / elderly relative moves in (new)' = both existing and new members.
• Đáp án đúng: A (This could cause unnecessary anxiety)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'People might worry about conditions which aren't serious at all.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'worry about conditions not serious' = cause unnecessary anxiety.
• Đáp án đúng: D (This would have environmental benefits)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'encourage more people to cycle, instead of using their car. Much better for the planet.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'better for the planet' = environmental benefits.

q29.text: restriction of cars to certain areas

steps: • Đáp án đúng: H (This would help some people but cause problems for others)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'Great for families with children. Maybe. But what if you're disabled or elderly... It wouldn't be so good for people like that.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'Great for families... wouldn't be so good for disabled/elderly' = help some people but cause problems for others.
• Đáp án đúng: G (This could enable retired people to share a project)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'great way for older people to get to know one another, especially if they're no longer going out to work (retired)... decide what to grow together (share a project).'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'no longer going out to work' = retired people.
